text:
Iris M: Heads-up — tiny hailstones near Embarcadero? Literally sounded like someone shaking a bag of pebbles on my car. Drive safe if you're heading in. :hail:
Ben L: Wow, hail? Rolled the windows up fast. Cable car lines say suspended due to lightning risk. Anyone relying on Powell lines?
José R: Ugh I usually take the Powell cable to work. Guess I'm switching to BART + shuttle.
Maya T: If you need a backup Clipper, I left one in the kitchen on the top shelf. First come, first serve.
TransitBot: Service update: San Francisco cable car lines suspended until further notice for safety inspections. Expect higher loads on MUNI bus routes.
WeatherBot: Thunderstorm warning until 09:15. Small hail possible, lightning detected within 10 miles.
Iris M: @Maya T you are a legend. I'll snag the Clipper and leave it at reception for José.
Ben L: For anyone driving, I-280 southbound moving slowly because of rubbernecking near the 16th Ave overpass. Give extra time.
José R: Thanks @Iris M — also FYI, my bike got pelted, so if someone has spare shoe covers, I could borrow.
Maya T: @José R there's a pair in the desk drawer labeled "spares". Feel free.
SnackKeeper: Office snack alert: emergency cookies deployed. Coffee: decaf only until restock at 11:00.
Ben L: Meme: "When the weather app says 'mostly sunny' but the sky disagrees" :joy: (posted GIF)
Iris M: Quick poll — standup at 10: in-person or remote? Reply with "in" or "remote".
Maya T: remote (lightning commute waiver)
José R: in (but late)
Ben L: remote — biking would be traumatic today
TransitBot: Alternative routes: use Bus 38 or 8; both seeing 15-20 min delays due to congestion.
Iris M: I'll keep the office open for anyone who braves it. Otherwise Zoom link same as usual.
José R: Thanks all — taking the shuttle and will DM when I'm at Reception.
Ben L: Stay dry y'all. If anyone needs an umbrella, I have an oversized one at the front desk.
Iris M: Closing note: watch for small hail on sidewalks, slippery tiles by the lobby entrance. Slippery sign posted. :warning:
